limitations: Conditional moments/quantiles/covariation summarize real joint observations; not a full probability density
No individual corpus rows, texts, identifiers or cache contents distributed
Human-only joint-available support differs from paired H-A contrast support
Not all humans share one style; source/bands are references, not universal targets
Do not force every dimension toward a mean or invent pronouns/claims to match numbers
Style/quality causality and independent human preference unvalidated; no detector success claim

measurement_definitions.T: Parser tokens excluding UPOS=PUNCT and all-punctuation/whitespace tokens; not character count or dictionary words
measurement_definitions.A: Nonroot nonpunctuation dependency arcs whose head and dependent both remain in lexical T; distance uses ranks after punctuation removal
measurement_definitions.component_weighting: Within each source, average all joint-valid HUMAN document-global vectors belonging to a component, then each component gets equal weight. Quantiles and covariance are over component-mean vectors.
measurement_definitions.null_policy: All10mustbeavailable for reference inclusion; zeroobserved retained, null notzero
measurement_definitions.band_ties: lower axis<=q1/3; middle q1/3<axis<=q2/3; upper axis>q2/3. Ties stay together; bands need not have equal counts.
